requirement: Desktop app: a link the window is asked to open goes where the routing table says, decided by the page and carried out once by the app

oracle.ref: PR #1064 (feat); fix evidence: tasks/evidence/desktop-window-shell/e2e/results.json (the same table pressed with real mouse input in the app on the local stand)
oracle.invariant: S1: third-party, non-http(s) and admin (wp-admin, wp-login.php, administrator, _emdash) addresses answer external; a front page of the site on screen answers tab with the address unchanged (served address, alias, alias on the served port; no other port); another of the viewer's sites answers navigate to /<siteKey>/?open=browser&page=<path+query+hash> (host= kept for an alias); /<siteKey>/..., /new and /ops on Tracy's origin answer navigate; anything else on Tracy's origin answers external. S2: no page listening, Cmd/middle/Shift click (any disposition but foreground-tab) open the browser unasked; an answer is carried out exactly once; no answer in time opens the browser once and a late answer does nothing; a navigation/crash/close drops pending questions without opening anything; an answer that navigates off Tracy's origin or opens a tab on another address opens the browser on the pressed address; only http(s) and mailto reach the operating system.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

off a site page (the creation workspace)

a plain click is asked about

no answer in time: the browser, once
the page going away (navigation, crash, close) drops what was asked
an answer that oversteps is not obeyed

only http(s) and mailto ever reach the operating system
